title: 3041. Maximize Consecutive Elements in an Array After Modification

examples.explanation: We can increase the elements at indices 0 and 3. The resulting array is nums = [3,1,5,2,1]. We select the elements [3,1,5,2,1] and we sort them to obtain [1,2,3], which are consecutive. It can be shown that we cannot select more than 3 consecutive elements.
The maximum consecutive elements that we can select is 1.
